topic: Analyzing sensor location data and demographics
summary_markdown: Someone analyzed the provided codes and regions used for demographic segmentation. They noted discrepancies, such as facility 3390 not being in Copenhagen, while Indre by is a central Copenhagen area. For facility 3390, the central Copenhagen area serves as the residential zone. This pattern of uniform residential areas was observed across most non-capital cities where sensors are located.
action_items: Discuss the sensor location data and demographic analysis on Monday.
